abilities.name: Leader
abilities.text: Before the battle, in the Muster Armies step, for each leader and support unit in your army, you can select one friendly bodyguard unit that unit can lead. Unless otherwise stated, each bodyguard unit can only have one leader unit and one support unit attached to it.
